name: monsera
description: Monsera platform: gateway + services. See README.md.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,payments,users,vend,admin,notify "npm --prefix ./monsera-gateway run start:dev" "npm --prefix ./monsera-payments run start:dev" "npm --prefix ./monsera-users-admin run start:dev" "npm --prefix ./monsera-vend-ingestion run start:dev" "npm --prefix ./monsera-admin run start:dev" "npm --prefix ./monsera-notifications run start:dev"
scripts.install:all: for d in db monsera-*; do (cd $d && npm ci) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:all: for d in monsera-*; do echo "== $d"; (cd $d && npm test --silent) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck:all: for d in monsera-*; do echo "== $d"; (cd $d && npm run typecheck --silent) || exit 1; done
